title: Harden CLI MVP acceptance

context.summary: Complete the CLI command surface against implemented API routes and add clear exit codes plus smoke coverage.
context.background: TASK-23 completed MCP stdio. The CLI now needs to behave like a usable MVP client for project, session, document, memory, context and job flows.

in: Add missing implemented API commands for session/message/job reads.
Require project ids on commands whose API routes are project-scoped.
Improve API and network error formatting with stable exit codes.
Add a CLI smoke script that validates the MVP route mapping and exit-code behavior.
Update CLI docs and validation scripts.
out: Run a live Docker/API E2E scenario.

acceptance_criteria: CLI includes project, session, message, document, memory, context and job commands for implemented API routes.
Project-scoped CLI commands require --project or --projects before calling the API.
HTTP API errors exit with code 3 and show status/code/message.
A CLI smoke script validates representative MVP commands and error behavior.
CLI remains HTTP-only and does not import database, queue, storage, vector, MCP SDK or Hermes internals.

manual_checks: Confirm project-scoped commands require project ids.
Confirm CLI smoke covers job get/list/retry and context build.
Confirm no external CLI framework was added.

risks: Smoke coverage uses the injectable API client and route mapping; live API acceptance remains for TASK-27.
Token creation remains listed as planned until the API implements token management routes.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
